services.title: Offshore and Subsea O&M
services.desc: Offshore and Subsea O&M services includes: the critical inspection, repair, and upkeep of marine infrastructure like oil rigs, wind farms, and pipelines, to ensure safety, efficiency, and longevity through specialized services such as:
subDescription: Corrosion Inspection thorough examination of structures and equipment to find, assess, and monitor corrosion using visual checks and advanced non-destructive testing (NDT) like ultrasonics, to ensure safety, preventing failures, and extending asset life by identifying issues like pitting, crevice, or galvanic corrosion, using tools from flashlights and scrapers to robotic crawlers and specialized probes;
Corrosion control including blasting/painting, grouting, Anode retrofit and anode sled installation to ensure asset integrity and operational safety;
Routine operations, using advanced techniques like Risk-Based Inspection (RBI) and specialized vessels to prevent downtime and maximize asset performance.

services.title: Offshore and Subsea Construction & Support
services.desc: Offshore and Subsea Construction & Support services include:
subDescription: Underwater Pipe and/or cable laying that involves specialized ships deploying armored fiber optic or power cables across the seabed, using plows to bury them in shallow areas for protection from fishing and anchors, while gravity handles deep-water placement, all managed with high precision for tension and route, connecting continents for global communication and energy. The process includes route surveying, burial, landing at onshore stations, and extensive permitting;
Varies of Offshore and Subsea construction support equipment to rent such as underwater HP Water Jet, Pipe Cutting, Bolt Tensioner, Generator Set, Mooring Buoy, Underwater Lift Bag, and Gas Detector.

equipment.title: SAAB Seaeye Falcon
equipment.description: Our ROV System SAAB Seaeye Falcon is considered the most successful electric robotic system of observation class and proven in intricate and demanding missions across industry. It provides exceptional vehicle control and diagnostic data as well as the ability to customize the pilot display. It is lightweight, portable, compact and is rated to a depth of 300 m

equipment.title: Survey and Positioning Tools & Equipment
equipment.description: Our Survey and Positioning Tools & Equipment are the most latest Survey and Positioning technology including: Gyrocompass, DGNSS Positioning System, USBL System, WSM Beacon, Telemetry, Navigation and Helsmann Software

equipment.title: Gas Detector
equipment.description: The Dragger X-Zone 5800 is a gas detector that can be used for the measurement of up to six gases. The internal pump and continuous power supply in the explosive area of Zone 0 extend the range of application in mobile gas detection technology

equipment.title: Mooring Set
equipment.description: Mooring Set in Offshore & Subsea equipment functions as an anchoring system to maintain the position of the floating structure or unit so that it remains stable and does not shift due to the influence of the marine environment.
